description: This source file defines a test configuration class used to control background activity during widget tests by disabling auto-start background work. It provides static variables and methods to manage and reset test-specific settings.

classes.name: TestConfig
classes.description: A class that provides static configuration options to modify test behavior, specifically to disable automatic background work during widget tests.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the test configuration options to their default values.
